title: Omega beams chasing moving targets
desc: 511's angular eye beams laid tick by tick after a moving target, re-aiming at every corner.

takes.name: Runner
takes.facts: mob sprinting across 18 blocks ahead at 6 b/s; fired tick 16, hit tick 51

takes.name: Dodger
takes.facts: mob zigzagging away, switching every 0.6 s; fired 16, hit 48

takes.name: Flyer
takes.facts: target circling at 12 b/s, 4-8 blocks up; fired 16, hit 39
